Alongside selling its flagship database software, Oracle now has $125 billion in debt as it funds an expansive buildout of data centers for AI workloads. The investment is expected to expand capacity for contracted cloud demand from customers including Nvidia, Meta, OpenAI, Advanced Micro Devices and SpaceX's AI business.
